questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to get a job at a big technology company
Why millennials start businesses, and if it helps
The history of the Nobel Peace Prize and its winners
How TV shows teach young people about business
questions.why: Rob says they'll look at why millennials start businesses and whether this makes the world better.

questions.q: What does Sam like about starting a business?
options: Making lots of money quickly
Working with friends
Becoming famous
Being her own boss
questions.why: Sam says, “I like the idea of being my own boss.”

questions.q: What are some millennials unhappy about?
options: Having to work from home without their friends
The rising cost of going to university
How big business uses social media data and harms society
The lack of good TV shows about business and money
questions.why: Sam mentions how big business uses social media data and companies' negative impact on society and the environment.

questions.q: According to Ethan Mollick, why is it easier to start a business now?
options: New platforms like crowdfunding, and lower costs
Banks lend money much more easily than before
Governments give free money to young people
There are fewer big companies to compete with
questions.why: He mentions platforms and crowdfunding, and says the cost of launching businesses dropped.

questions.q: What used to be one of the main problems in starting a business?
options: Finding good staff
Getting the large amount of money needed
Finding an office
Getting permission from the government
questions.why: Rob says one of the main problems used to be getting the large amounts of money needed.

options: Only businesses can really solve the world's big problems
Governments should stay out of the economy completely
Talented young people could do more good in government
Millennials should not start businesses of their own
questions.why: He says the more committed, smart young people work in government, the better governments deliver services.

questions.q: Why does Charles Kenny mention corrupt and inefficient governments?
options: To say fixing them is one of the best ways to help
To warn millennials never to trust any politicians
To explain why so many new businesses fail early
To show that governments are always the real problem
questions.why: He says in such places, one of the best ways to push development is to make that problem better.

questions.q: According to Charles Kenny, how can problems like corrupt government be improved?
options: By one brave individual
By foreign businesses
By crowdfunding
Through a collective effort
questions.why: He says it's not something one individual can do; 'it has to be a collective effort'.
